base.title: 《树语》
base.markdown:
# 微型剧本：《树语》  
**类型**：自然寓言 / 荒诞现实 / 哲思 / 哀歌  
**时长**：约6分钟  
**总剧情点**：6个  
**导演人格**：是枝裕和 × 乔治·桑塔耶娜  

---

## 全局基调

- **核心题旨**：当人以“拥有”之名靠近自然，便在无声中悄然剥夺了万物本就属于时间与流动的尊严。  
- **视觉风格**：冷调胶片质感 + 轻微褪色 + 极简构图 + 植物生长的动态缓慢推进  
- **叙事手法**：线性推进但穿插记忆闪回与自然生长的平行叙事，用“树”的生命周期隐喻人类占有行为的荒谬与代价  
- **叙事视角**：第一人称内视角，叙述者为一名年轻植物学家，以“我”见证一棵树的死亡与重生  
- **音乐基调**：空灵古琴铺底，渐入微弱的风铃声，节奏缓慢如呼吸，后期加入疏离的电子脉冲模仿机械计时  
- **情绪弧线**：平静 → 疑惑 → 惊惧 → 悔悟 → 静默 → 余韵荡开  
- **特殊手法**：  
  - 树的“生长”与“枯萎”以倒放影像交错呈现（视觉反讽）  
  - 关键道具“刻痕”在不同场景中以不同角度、不同时间出现，构成伏笔  
  - 所有对话均以低语形式出现，音量递减，接近风声  

---

## 人物表
| 角色名 | 身份 | 外观特征 | 性格 |
|--------|------|----------|------|
| 林远 | 年轻植物学家 | 28岁，灰白衬衫，袖口磨出毛边，左耳戴一只老旧金属耳夹，右肩有道浅疤 | 思辨而克制，习惯在笔记本上画树的剖面，说话时总不抬头看人 |
| 树（无名） | 自然实体 | 无具体形态，仅通过光影与枝干动线呈现，每帧都像在呼吸 | 无意识，但通过“生长”与“断裂”表达存在意志 |

---

## 场景表
| 场景名 | 地点 | 时间 | 环境描述 |
|--------|------|------|----------|
| S01 树影初现 | 深山边缘的废弃苗圃 | 黄昏 | 冷调蓝灰为主，光线从斜坡渗入，植物叶片泛着银尘，镜头中树影缓慢爬行至墙角，仿佛自画布生长而出 |
| S02 刻痕之始 | 荒废苗圃的木门内 | 白天 | 铁锈色阳光穿透破窗，墙上有一道浅浅的刻痕，如同被手指划过，可辨是“2013”字样，风吹时若隐若现 |
| S03 树冠之约 | 小径旁林中 | 午后 | 林间雾气弥漫，树干粗大如老人手臂，林远伸出手指轻触树皮，树影在地面上向他缓缓移动，如回应 |
| S04 人工之裂 | 移植实验区 | 夜晚 | 人工温室，灯光过强，树干被锯开一段，露出内部脉络，灯光下树心泛黄，像血管破裂 |
| S05 树语归零 | 林间空地 | 深夜 | 月光如霜，树木静止，林远蹲下，树皮裂开，露出内层枯黄，地面渗出微光，如液态月光 |
| S06 微光重燃 | 山顶荒地 | 黎明 | 被砍伐的树桩边缘长出新芽，轻轻摇晃，新芽叶脉清晰，边缘如被水洗过，画面缓慢推近至芽尖 |

---

## 剧本正文

### S01 树影初现 内 日/黄昏 ｜ [00:00–00:45]

*“我第一次看见树影，它不是在山坡，而是在墙角，像一个刚刚醒来的梦。”*

镜头从地面缓慢推升，树影在裂缝中蠕动，如呼吸，叶片边缘泛着蓝银色水光。林远站在栅栏外，背影被拉长，影子与树影重叠，轻轻晃动。他抬手，指尖掠过墙角，空气中有轻微摩擦声。

    【林远】：（低语，眼神迟疑）“它在动……不是风，是它们在说话。”  

音效：风穿林叶的“沙沙”声，远处山涧水滴声“嘀嗒、嘀嗒”，偶尔有鸟鸣被截断。

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：静止推镜 → 微幅摇移（0.5秒/次）  
> - 构图视角：低机位仰拍，树影占据画面左下角，人物轮廓被拉长  
> - 光影：斜侧光，冷灰蓝调，光斑细碎，对比度低，情绪静谧却有压迫感  
> - 色彩：色温 4500K，饱和度30%，主导色银灰 + 淡蓝，情绪如雾起  
> - 氛围：静默中的潜在威胁，强度中  
> - 音乐：古琴独奏，泛音缓慢上升，节奏极缓  
> - 转场：入 风吹落叶飘入镜头 ／ 出 仰拍转为平视  
> - 叙事功能：建立“树”作为异质存在的初始感知，埋下“它在动”的悬念  

---

### S02 刻痕之始 内 白天 ｜ [00:46–01:20]

*“我问自己，谁会在2013年刻下这个数字？那年我还没出生。”*

林远站在木门内，手扶墙，左耳的金属耳夹被风吹动，发出微弱的“叮”声。墙上“2013”刻痕模糊，如被雨水冲刷，手指轻触边缘，刻痕微微变形，像活物呼吸。

    【林远】：（自言自语，手指颤抖）“它记得我之前来过……可我不记得我来过。”  

音效：铁门轻微吱呀，铁锈摩擦声，风吹过纸页的“哗啦”声，远处传来水泵滴水声。

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：固定长镜头 + 手持轻微晃动（模拟记忆错位）  
> - 构图视角：正拍，刻痕居中，人物左半身被光影分割，右半侧空无  
> - 光影：前侧光，强光造成明暗分界，阴影边缘有细微反光，情绪悬疑  
> - 色彩：色温 4800K，饱和度40%，主导色铁灰 + 淡褐，情绪压抑  
> - 氛围：记忆失真，强度高  
> - 音乐：古琴变调，节奏微拖，加入细微电子脉冲  
> - 转场：入 指尖触痕瞬间放大，纹理浮现 ／ 出 镜头切至林远背影远去  
> - 叙事功能：首次出现“占有”痕迹，暗示人类在自然中“留痕”即等于“侵占”  

---

### S03 树冠之约 内 午后 ｜ [01:21–02:05]

*“我伸手去碰它的时候，它也伸手回握了。”*

镜头从林远的视角推进，他站在林中，阳光透过树叶斑驳洒落，树冠像伞盖般覆盖他。他缓慢伸出右手，指尖轻触树干，树皮纹路如年轮般清晰。树影在地面上向他移动，像在回应。

    【林远】：（呼吸变缓，语气平静）“原来，它不是不动。它只是在等我，等一个愿意相信它的人。”  

音效：树叶摆动声“簌簌”，风穿过树隙的“嗡”声，微弱的虫鸣  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：手持平移 + 跟拍（轻微前倾）  
> - 构图视角：中景，人物与树干分别为画面两侧，树影在地面上形成对称三角  
> - 光影：自然侧光，暖调偏黄，光斑规律排列，情绪温柔但有张力  
> - 色彩：色温 5500K，饱和度50%，主导色黄绿 + 淡褐，情绪信任感强  
> - 氛围：温柔中带警觉，强度中等  
> - 音乐：古琴旋律回归，加入轻微弦乐泛音  
> - 转场：入 指尖触碰瞬间转为慢推树干全景 ／ 出 画面切至树影缓慢爬行  
> - 叙事功能：建立“人与树”间互为主体的共感，点题“拥有”需双向认知  

---

### S04 人工之裂 内 夜晚 ｜ [02:06–03:10]

*“他们说，一把锯子能拯救一棵树。可锯子划开的，是它的记忆。”*

实验室里灯光惨白，林远站在锯下树干前，锯齿在光下闪烁，树心被剖开，内部脉络如血管断裂般显现，黄色汁液在静止中缓慢渗出。他伸手触碰，树心如呼吸，波动细微。

    【林远】：（声音颤抖，近乎耳语）“它在痛……痛得像我第一次被拒绝申请课题时那样。”  

音效：锯齿“吱——”声，慢放中液体滴落“滴、滴、滴”，灯泡偶尔闪烁  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：手持晃动 + 慢动作（0.5倍速）+ 特写拉伸  
> - 构图视角：低角仰拍，树干剖面占据画面三分之二，林远在底部小如尘埃  
> - 光影：前侧强光，冷白，光线不均匀，对比度高，情绪压抑  
> - 色彩：色温 6500K，饱和度55%，主导色白黄 + 淡红，情绪残酷  
> - 氛围：震惊与痛感并存，强度高  
> - 音乐：古琴节奏骤停，电子脉冲突起，节奏如心跳撕裂  
> - 转场：入 锯开瞬间慢放，树心裂开 ／ 出 切至黑屏，仅余滴水声  
> - 叙事功能：揭示“占有”行为的本质——用工具强行切割生命，制造“我拥有”的假象  

---

### S05 树语归零 内 深夜 ｜ [03:11–04:00]

*“我听见它在说：你拿走了我的名字，你拿走了我呼吸的方式。”*

林远蹲在树根旁，树干裂开，露出腐朽的内层。月光穿过，树心呈玻璃状透明，内中流动着微光，像液态星光。他听见风穿过裂口，声音如低语，缓慢、回荡。

    【林远】：（声音破碎，几乎失声）“我……我只想要理解它……可我却把它变成了一件展品。”  

音效：风穿过树裂口的“呜——”，液体流动声“汩汩”，远处无意义的钟声  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：固定长镜头 + 极慢推镜（0.25倍速）  
> - 构图视角：地面平视，树干裂口居中，人物在下方，形成“被吞噬感”  
> - 光影：月光侧入，冷白，光质柔和，对比度极低，情绪悲切  
> - 色彩：色温 3800K，饱和度20%，主导色灰白 + 淡蓝，情绪沉寂  
> - 氛围：哀悼与自我谴责，强度极高  
> - 音乐：古琴彻底静音，仅保留风声本底，随后电子脉冲渐弱成白噪音  
> - 转场：入 树心微光漂浮，转为模糊黑场 ／ 出 黑屏，只留风声三秒  
> - 叙事功能：高潮场景，完成对“占有”行为的道德审判，情绪彻底崩塌  

---

### S06 微光重燃 内 黎明 ｜ [04:01–04:55]

*“新芽没有刻痕。它生长，像从未被人类触碰过。”*

山顶荒地，风拂过，断树桩边缘，一枚嫩芽缓缓抬起头，叶脉清晰如初生之笔。镜头缓慢推近，芽尖微微颤动，阳光洒下，光斑在地面上形成完整弧线。

    【林远】：（轻声，近乎叹息）“也许，万物从不需要被‘拥有’。它们只是需要被‘看见’。”  

音效：芽叶轻微“沙沙”声，风拂过山脊的“呼——”，清晨鸟鸣第一声  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：推镜 + 轻微晃动，最后以微距定格芽尖  
> - 构图视角：仰视 + 极近距离推镜，芽尖与镜头平齐  
> - 光影：侧斜光，暖黄，柔和，对比度极低，情绪治愈  
> - 色彩：色温 5800K，饱和度60%，主导色金黄 + 浅绿，情绪再生  
> - 氛围：宁静、余韵、希望，强度低但深远  
> - 音乐：古琴重新响起，单音线回归，缓缓滑向余音  
> - 转场：入 芽尖呼吸般微微颤动 ／ 出 镜头缓缓拉远，树桩与晨光融为一体  
> - 叙事功能：完成闭环，通过“无刻痕”的新芽，反证“占有”不可持续，自然自有生命秩序  

---

**——全剧终——**

en.title: Tree Language
en.markdown:
# Short screenplay: Tree Language
**Genre:** Nature fable / absurd realism / philosophical reflection / elegy  
**Duration:** Approximately 6 minutes  
**Plot points:** 6  
**Directorial sensibility:** Hirokazu Kore-eda × George Santayana

---

## Overall tone

- **Central theme:** Approaching nature in the name of ownership quietly strips living things of the dignity that belongs to time and change.
- **Visual style:** Cool film texture, slight fading, minimalist compositions, and slowly advancing plant growth.
- **Narrative technique:** Linear progression interspersed with memories and a parallel account of natural growth. A tree's life cycle becomes a metaphor for the absurdity and cost of human possession.
- **Perspective:** First-person interior narration by a young botanist witnessing a tree's death and rebirth.
- **Music:** Airy guqin, gradually joined by faint wind chimes; a breathing pace, with detached electronic pulses later imitating mechanical timekeeping.
- **Emotional arc:** Calm → doubt → fear → remorse → silence → lingering resonance.
- **Special devices:**
  - Reversed images interweave growth and withering as visual irony.
  - A carved mark recurs at different angles and times as foreshadowing.
  - All dialogue is whispered, gradually diminishing toward the volume of wind.

## Characters

| Name | Identity | Appearance | Personality |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Lin Yuan | Young botanist | 28; gray-white shirt with frayed cuffs, an old metal clip on his left ear, a faint scar on his right shoulder | Reflective and restrained; draws tree cross-sections in a notebook and never looks up at people when speaking |
| Tree (unnamed) | Natural entity | No definite form; conveyed through light, shadow, and the movement of branches; every frame seems to breathe | Unconscious, yet expresses a will to exist through growth and fracture |

## Scene list

| Scene | Location | Time | Environment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| S01 The first tree shadow | Abandoned nursery at the edge of the mountains | Dusk | Cool blue-gray light seeps down the slope. Silver dust glints on leaves. A tree shadow crawls toward a wall corner, as though growing from a canvas. |
| S02 The first mark | Inside the nursery's wooden door | Day | Rust-colored sunlight enters a broken window. A shallow wall scratch, like a fingertip's trace, reads “2013,” appearing and fading in the wind. |
| S03 A promise beneath the canopy | Woods beside a path | Afternoon | Mist surrounds a trunk as thick as an old man's arm. Lin Yuan touches its bark; its shadow moves toward him in response. |
| S04 The artificial fracture | Transplantation experiment area | Night | An overlit greenhouse. A section of trunk has been sawn open, exposing inner veins; its yellow heartwood resembles ruptured blood vessels. |
| S05 Tree language returns to zero | Forest clearing | Late night | Frostlike moonlight and motionless trees. Lin Yuan crouches as bark splits to expose dry yellow layers. Light seeps from the ground like liquid moonlight. |
| S06 A glimmer rekindled | Barren mountaintop | Dawn | A shoot trembles at the edge of a felled stump. Clear veins and washed-looking leaf edges; the camera advances toward its tip. |

## Screenplay

### S01 The first tree shadow · INT. · Day / dusk ｜ [00:00–00:45]

*“The first time I saw the tree's shadow, it wasn't on the hillside. It was in the corner of a wall, like a dream just waking up.”*

The camera slowly rises from the ground. The shadow writhes in a crack, breathing; blue-silver moisture shines at the leaf edges. Lin Yuan stands outside the fence, his elongated silhouette overlapping the swaying tree shadow. He raises a hand and brushes the corner with his fingertips. A faint friction sounds in the air.

    LIN YUAN (whispering, uncertain): “It's moving… It isn't the wind. They're talking.”

Sound: Leaves rustling, distant mountain-stream droplets ticking, an occasional birdsong cut short.

> **Audiovisual notes**
> - Camera: Stationary push-in → tiny pans, 0.5 seconds each.
> - Composition: Low angle; tree shadow fills the lower left, elongating the figure.
> - Lighting: Oblique sidelight, cool gray-blue, small patches, low contrast; quiet but oppressive.
> - Color: 4500K; 30% saturation; silver-gray and pale blue; mistlike feeling.
> - Atmosphere: A latent threat in silence; medium intensity.
> - Music: Solo guqin, slowly rising harmonics, extremely slow rhythm.
> - Transition: In—windblown leaves enter frame; out—low angle becomes eye level.
> - Narrative function: Establish the tree as an unfamiliar presence and the mystery of its movement.

---

### S02 The first mark · INT. · Day ｜ [00:46–01:20]

*“I asked myself who could have carved that number in 2013. I hadn't even been born then.”*

Lin Yuan stands inside the wooden door, a hand against the wall. Wind moves his metal ear clip with a faint chime. The “2013” carving looks rain-washed and blurred. As he touches its edge, the mark shifts slightly, like something alive breathing.

    LIN YUAN (to himself, fingers trembling): “It remembers me being here before… But I don't remember coming.”

Sound: A slight iron-door creak, rust scraping, wind ruffling pages, a distant pump dripping.

> **Audiovisual notes**
> - Camera: Fixed long take with slight handheld shake to suggest displaced memory.
> - Composition: Frontal; carving centered; light divides his left side, while the right side is empty.
> - Lighting: Strong front-side light divides light and dark, with faint reflection at shadow edges; suspenseful.
> - Color: 4800K; 40% saturation; iron-gray and light brown; oppressive.
> - Atmosphere: Distorted memory; high intensity.
> - Music: Guqin changes key, its rhythm dragging slightly, with faint electronic pulses.
> - Transition: In—enlarge the instant fingers touch the mark, revealing texture; out—cut to Lin Yuan walking away.
> - Narrative function: Introduce possession's first trace: leaving a human mark on nature implies encroachment.

---

### S03 A promise beneath the canopy · INT. · Afternoon ｜ [01:21–02:05]

*“When I reached out to touch it, it reached back and held my hand.”*

The camera advances from Lin Yuan's perspective. He stands among trees, dappled sunlight falling through the leaves, the canopy covering him like an umbrella. Slowly, he extends his right hand and touches the trunk. The bark's patterns are as clear as growth rings. Its shadow moves toward him across the ground, as if responding.

    LIN YUAN (breathing more slowly, calm): “So it wasn't motionless. It was just waiting for me. Waiting for someone willing to believe in it.”

Sound: Leaves swishing, wind humming through gaps between trees, faint insects.

> **Audiovisual notes**
> - Camera: Handheld lateral movement and tracking, leaning slightly forward.
> - Composition: Medium shot; figure and trunk on opposite sides; ground shadows form a symmetrical triangle.
> - Lighting: Natural sidelight, warm yellow, regularly spaced patches; tender yet tense.
> - Color: 5500K; 50% saturation; yellow-green and pale brown; strong trust.
> - Atmosphere: Tenderness with vigilance; medium intensity.
> - Music: Guqin melody returns with faint string harmonics.
> - Transition: In—touch leads to a slow push toward a full view of the trunk; out—cut to the crawling shadow.
> - Narrative function: Establish mutual subjecthood and empathy between human and tree; possession requires reciprocal recognition.

---

### S04 The artificial fracture · INT. · Night ｜ [02:06–03:10]

*“They said a saw could save a tree. But what the saw cut open was its memory.”*

Under the laboratory's pallid lights, Lin Yuan stands before the sawn-off trunk. Saw teeth gleam. The split heartwood exposes veins like broken blood vessels, yellow sap slowly seeping through the stillness. He reaches out. The heartwood moves almost imperceptibly, as though breathing.

    LIN YUAN (shaking voice, almost inaudible): “It's hurting… Like I hurt the first time my research proposal was rejected.”

Sound: Saw teeth screech; slow-motion drops fall one by one; a bulb occasionally flickers.

> **Audiovisual notes**
> - Camera: Handheld shake, half-speed slow motion, stretched close-up.
> - Composition: Low angle; cross-section occupies two-thirds of the image, Lin Yuan tiny as dust below.
> - Lighting: Strong front-side cold white light, uneven and high-contrast; oppressive.
> - Color: 6500K; 55% saturation; white-yellow and pale red; cruel.
> - Atmosphere: Shock and pain; high intensity.
> - Music: Guqin stops abruptly; electronic pulses erupt like a tearing heartbeat.
> - Transition: In—slow the sawing as heartwood splits; out—black screen with dripping alone.
> - Narrative function: Reveal possession as forcibly cutting life with tools to produce an illusion of ownership.

---

### S05 Tree language returns to zero · INT. · Late night ｜ [03:11–04:00]

*“I heard it say: You took away my name. You took away the way I breathe.”*

Lin Yuan crouches by the roots. The trunk cracks open, exposing decay. Moonlight passes through the glasslike heartwood, where faint light flows like liquid starlight. Wind whispers slowly through the opening, echoing.

    LIN YUAN (voice breaking, almost voiceless): “I… I only wanted to understand it… But I turned it into an exhibit.”

Sound: Wind moaning through the split, liquid gurgling, a meaningless distant bell.

> **Audiovisual notes**
> - Camera: Fixed long take with an extremely slow push, quarter speed.
> - Composition: Ground-level eye line; split centered, figure beneath it, creating a sense of being swallowed.
> - Lighting: Soft cold white moonlight from the side; extremely low contrast; sorrowful.
> - Color: 3800K; 20% saturation; gray-white and pale blue; stillness.
> - Atmosphere: Mourning and self-reproach; extremely intense.
> - Music: Guqin falls completely silent; wind remains, then electronic pulses fade into white noise.
> - Transition: In—floating heartwood light blurs into darkness; out—black screen with three seconds of wind.
> - Narrative function: Climax and moral judgment of possession; complete emotional collapse.

---

### S06 A glimmer rekindled · INT. · Dawn ｜ [04:01–04:55]

*“The new shoot has no carvings. It grows as though humans had never touched it.”*

Wind sweeps the barren mountaintop. At the stump's edge, a tender shoot slowly raises its head, its veins as clear as a first brushstroke. The camera moves closer. The tip trembles, sunlight falls, and patches of light form an unbroken arc on the ground.

    LIN YUAN (softly, almost sighing): “Perhaps nothing ever needed to be ‘owned.’ Perhaps it only needed to be ‘seen.’”

Sound: Faint rustling of new leaves, wind across the ridge, the first morning birdcall.

> **Audiovisual notes**
> - Camera: Slightly unsteady push-in, ending in a macro freeze-frame of the shoot tip.
> - Composition: Low angle and extremely close push-in; tip level with the lens.
> - Lighting: Soft oblique warm yellow sidelight; extremely low contrast; healing.
> - Color: 5800K; 60% saturation; golden yellow and light green; regeneration.
> - Atmosphere: Peace, resonance, hope; low but far-reaching intensity.
> - Music: Guqin returns as a single melodic line, easing into its final resonance.
> - Transition: In—the shoot trembles like breathing; out—camera retreats until stump and dawn merge.
> - Narrative function: Close the cycle: the unmarked shoot shows possession is unsustainable and nature has its own order.

**— End —**

rare.title: 《树语者》
rare.markdown:
# 微型剧本：《树语者》  
**类型**：自然寓言 / 哲思 / 剧情 / 宫廷幻想  
**时长**：约6分钟  
**总剧情点**：6个  
**导演人格**：是枝裕和 × 余华《活着》式节制残酷  

---

## 全局基调  

- **核心题旨**：一棵千年古树生长于山中，有人为取其果、其根、其魂而强行占有，最终发现所谓“拥有”不过是短暂的伤痕，自然以沉默的枯萎与再生告诫人类不可僭越自然的边界。  
- **视觉风格**：超现实写实主义，树木以近乎拟人化的纹理与呼吸感呈现，山林静谧中藏有细微的具象变化，如叶脉微震、根系流动；材质质感真实，苔藓、泥土、木质纹理清晰，色彩偏冷蓝绿，带有古旧与生命衰减的调性。  
- **叙事手法**：线性推进，以“人对树的占有行为”为线索，层层递进至无法挽回的自然反噬。  
- **叙事视角**：第三人称全知视角，聚焦主角“林野”对古树的占有过程，穿插树的“低语”作为隐性声音线。  
- **音乐基调**：空灵古琴与细弱电子脉冲混合，类似森林中的呼吸声，节奏缓慢、渐进式失真，情绪从安宁到断裂。  
- **情绪弧线**：平静 → 渴望 → 侵占 → 惊惧 → 被剥夺 → 沉默余温 → 植物再生之静  
- **特殊手法**：  
  - “树语”以身体反应（如枝条微动、树皮渗出黑液、根部细微颤动）作为台词外化，形成“自然语言”；  
  - 重复母题：每一次“占有行为”后，树皮裂纹增加一寸，伴随林野的徒劳之感增强；  
  - 伏笔：林野幼时曾听老人说“树不回答，你便是错的”，后被忽视，此句在结尾被无意复现；  
  - 用“静态”与“动态”的对抗表现“占据”的短暂性——人类动作越急，自然界反应越缓慢却越彻底。  

---

## 人物表  
| 角色名 | 身份 | 外观特征 | 性格 |  
|--------|------|----------|------|  
| 林野 | 伐木工兼祖传地主，妄图“拥有”古树 | 三十岁，瘦削脸庞，穿磨损工装裤，右袖口有树皮血痕，戴铁质护腕，常握铁镐 | 好强、固执，认为“山里的东西是家产”，习惯在树干上刻字、钉钉、埋石块 |  
| 古树（无名） | 千年古木，拥有“低语”与“反应能力” | 无具体脸部，树干如青铜古器，皮层有裂纹与发光纹路，根部延伸至地下30米，叶片微颤如呼吸 | 无言，但通过节奏、液体渗出、结构变化回应人类行为 |  

---

## 场景表  
| 场景名 | 地点 | 时间 | 环境描述 |  
|--------|------|------|----------|  
| S01 山口初见 | 山脚林边，石径通向古林 | 黄昏 | 山风轻拂，林木静默，古树立于中央，树皮泛青白，叶片如薄纱轻摆；林野骑旧摩托停靠，眼中带着试探与热望。 |  
| S02 刻名与采果 | 古树南侧 | 日中 | 林野割下第一片果实，用刀刻“林家第3代”于树皮，树皮微颤，渗出暗褐汁液，风中声若低语。 |  
| S03 根系牢笼 | 树根下 | 夜 | 林野挖开树根，用铁网封住主根三根，试图锁住树体移动；树根抽动，泥土崩裂，地面出现裂痕。 |  
| S04 阴雨断语 | 古林内 | 暴雨夜 | 天降大雨，林野发现树根无法稳住，大片枝叶折断，树皮露出断裂纹路；他狂喊“这是我的树”，树回应以根部悬空、响声如断裂骨。 |  
| S05 被夺之灵 | 林野家屋内 | 次日清晨 | 林野清晨醒来，发现铁网锈蚀、刻字风化，树皮上浮现新纹路，纹理如伤疤蔓延；他试图捡起木芯，木芯已枯，燃烧后无烟。 |  
| S06 树语重生 | 山口 | 冬末春初 | 林野默默坐于树前，树干新叶萌发，裂纹愈合，缓缓舒展叶片，风过处飘出类似人声的低语——“你曾迫我呼吸。” |  

---

## 剧本正文  

### S01 山口初见 内/外 黄昏 ｜ [00:00–00:38]  

*“它一直在等我，等我来认领。”*  

林野骑着旧摩托停在树前，车灯扫过树皮，像照进墓穴。树干高约十米，人无法直视其顶，只看见枝叶交织如云，风拂时沙沙作响，树身有七道深纹，如掌印。他慢慢下骑，从背包取出一小袋种子，压进树根裂缝中。他指节微抖，抚摸树皮，起初是敬畏，很快变成兴奋。树皮表面忽然微发烫，液滴从主干裂隙渗出，像血。他伸手接住，倒进玻璃瓶——瓶壁泛黑。  

    【林野】：（低声，几乎自语）“之前老辈说山不许人占，我说是迷信。可它现在在回应，对吧？”  

音效：风穿过叶片、远处鸟鸣、摩托熄火声、金属车架摩擦声  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：近景 → 中景推移，缓慢推近树皮裂纹  
> - 构图视角：低角度仰拍，树在画面中占70%，林野居右下  
> - 光影：侧逆光，冷黄光与蓝调交叠，树皮反光泛绿，对比如风掠过般轻柔  
> - 色彩：色温 6500K，低饱和，主导色：青灰+薄绿，情绪为“初探的渴望”  
> - 氛围：静谧中藏细微搏动，如呼吸，强度中  
> - 音乐：古琴单音长音，类似“空谷回声”，节奏稳定  
> - 转场：入 模糊渐入 ／ 出 风声带下切  
> - 叙事功能：建立主角对树的误判——“自然可被识别、可被动作影响”  

---

### S02 刻名与采果 内/外 日中 ｜ [00:39–01:22]  

*“我得证明我拥有它。”*  

林野用铁柄小刀在树干南侧刻下“林家第3代”，刀锋划过时，树皮发出细微“咔”声，如骨节开合。他摘下第一枝果，果皮如琥珀，内含光点。他将果浸入水杯，观察其脉络——果然有微弱搏动，像心脏。他兴奋，拍树干，说：“以后我养它，让它结果。”他从口袋掏出绵纸，将树根处的泥土轻轻覆盖，像种花。  

树根微微抽动，泥土中传出类似低频的“嗡”声，水杯中果液忽然浑浊，浮出黑色絮。林野未发觉，继续在树干上刻“3年回报”，刻完后大口喘气，像在酷刑后出气。他将果藏进木盒，背起铁镐准备离开。  

    【林野】：（喘着，语气强硬）“它说我是主人，就该结出宝物。”  

音效：刀刻声、果液流动声、树皮微震声、远处鸟啄声  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：特写刀刻 → 中景果的细节拍摄 → 镜头缓慢拉远  
> - 构图视角：正前方平视，人物居中，树为背景，裂纹清晰可见  
> - 光影：正午强光，树皮阴影深，形成强烈明暗对比，增强“占有”的刺目感  
> - 色彩：色温 5600K，高饱和，主导色：琥珀黄+深褐，情绪为“占有欲膨胀”  
> - 氛围：躁动、失控，强度高  
> - 音乐：古琴节奏加快，加入电子鼓点，似攻击性节奏  
> - 转场：入 渐入（刀声） ／ 出 切至果液晃动  
> - 叙事功能：首次“占有”行为，形成伏笔——树的“回应”变为入侵性反应  

---

### S03 根系牢笼 内/外 夜 ｜ [01:23–02:45]  

*“它会跑，我得锁住它。”*  

深夜，林野带着铁锹和钢网，潜入树根下3米深。他用铁丝网缠住三根主根，再用木桩钉牢，铁钉插进树皮，发出“咯吱”声。他用铁锤敲击根部，说：“你不能动，你属于我。”树根剧烈抖动，泥土塌陷，出现深裂，地表如隆起的伤口。风声停止，林野大喊“你听到了吗？你动不了了！”树根连动三下，一寸裂纹自地下向上蔓延，渗出粘稠黑液，滴落进泥中。  

他点燃火把照根，发现根部有细小发光虫群在爬动，他慌张扑打，虫群飞散，黑液滑出，像血。他吞下一片土，喃喃：“老规矩，人不许占山，可这树是死物，我全拿走，它就该死。”他把铁网铁链补强，坚信“再也不会被夺走”。  

音效：铁锤敲击、泥土塌陷声、黑液滑落、微弱电子哼鸣声  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：俯拍根部 → 微距特写黑液滴落 → 镜头缓慢后退  
> - 构图视角：俯角，根部占画面60%，林野在前，被压迫感强烈  
> - 光影：侧光，铁网反射冷光，树根在阴影中发光如脉搏，高对比  
> - 色彩：色温 4800K，偏冷，主导色：黑灰+荧绿，情绪为“恐惧与狂热交织”  
> - 氛围：压迫、不安，强度高，有生理不适感  
> - 音乐：电子音变调，频率逐渐扭曲，如生命被切割  
> - 转场：入 摇晃消失 ／ 出 黑液滴落声起  
> - 叙事功能：第一次“终极占有”失败，树开始系统性反制，裂纹蔓延为自然体征  

---

### S04 阴雨断语 内/外 暴雨夜 ｜ [02:46–04:05]  

*“它在断，我不能看着它断。”*  

暴雨倾盆，林野为防根部受潮，执意在树南侧打两根木桩加固铁网。雨水冲刷树皮，裂纹部分迅速扩大，根部传来“咔哒”声，如骨节断裂。他上树，伸手去拉铁网，发现其中一根根须被拔出，泥中满是根络伸展，像在挣扎。他大喊：“树！你谁的？！”树干表面瞬间抽搐，叶子如被风撕扯，集体下垂，叶片边缘出现裂口，渗出暗红液，滑向地面。  

他冲进屋，烧水想煮身体发热，却发现树根部排水孔处出现新根丛，向空气伸展。他怒吼：“你活不了，我封死你！”他用力砸铁网，网片反弹，嵌入树皮，树皮裂口扩大，发出如呻吟的“呜——”声。  

他慌乱爬回树边，拍打树干，却发现树干上多了一行新刻痕——“汝当归，汝当息。”字迹如被水浸，模糊如泪痕。他手抖，发疯般撕开木盒，想拿回早前那颗果，却发现果已干裂，黑中带枯。  

音效：暴雨声、根部撕裂声、树干呻吟、水滴砸叶声、铁网碎裂声  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：手持晃动 → 特写裂口扩大 → 叶片飘落 → 推近渗液  
> - 构图视角：中景以仰角拍摄树，主体在画面中央偏上，强调崩塌感  
> - 光影：逆光+雨雾弥漫，侧光打在树裂处形成投影，光斑像伤口  
> - 色彩：色温 4000K，低饱和，主导色：铁灰+暗红，情绪为“崩溃”  
> - 氛围：绝望、被剥夺感，强度极高  
> - 音乐：古琴声中断，电子音被切碎、衰减，仅剩静电杂音  
> - 转场：入 暴雨突入 ／ 出 液体滴落声延续  
> - 叙事功能：核心转折点——“占有”行为导致自然反噬，主角陷入心理崩溃，树反象征“拥有者需修与自然共呼吸”  

---

### S05 被夺之灵 内/外 次日清晨 ｜ [04:06–05:10]  

林野清晨醒来，天未亮。他走进屋，脚边铁网锈蚀严重，铁钉已经松动，树根处布满青苔，新芽已钻出。他试着去拿铁盒里那个果，却发现它早已干裂，指尖触到时有刺痛感。他冷笑：“这不就是毒果？我早该扔了。”他骂树：“你害我，你不该活这么久！”  

他洗漱后，发现树干上那句“汝当归，汝当息”字迹已清晰，还出现了新纹——像一条蛇在树皮蜿蜒。他碰触，树皮微颤，渗出微光。他跪下，想哭，却只觉喉咙干涩。他脸贴树干，忽然听见“嘀……”一声，如呼吸，空谷回声。他后退，发抖。  

他翻箱找旧证件，翻出老父亲的笔记：“山不许人占，树有知。不语，是它不许你懂。”他扑通坐在地上，把笔记撕成碎纸，扔进火炉。火熄后，纸灰飘落，隐约清晰写下：“你吃进它的血，它便吐出你的魂。”  

音效：晨风、铁锈摩擦声、碎纸声、微弱的“嗡”声如在树根回响  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：中景推近树皮 → 特写新纹蔓延 → 林野跪地镜头缓慢放慢  
> - 构图视角：平视，主体为树与人，象征“被自然覆盖”  
> - 光影：晨光斜照，树皮反光柔和，裂纹边缘泛金，呈现修复之兆  
> - 色彩：色温 5800K，中等饱和，主导色：浅绿+灰白，情绪为“认知崩塌”  
> - 氛围：伤痛、虚无，强度高  
> - 音乐：古琴零星出现，如风中残音，调性微变  
> - 转场：入 静默对视 ／ 出 纸灰飘落声  
> - 叙事功能：揭示“占有”代价——树的回归是人的精神退场，伏笔回应生效  

---

### S06 树语重生 内/外 冬末春初 ｜ [05:11–06:00]  

林野坐在树前，不再碰它。他脱下铁护腕，放在树根裂口，看着新芽缓慢钻出——嫩绿如初生绒毛。风过时，树冠轻摆，叶片微颤，仿佛在呼吸。他不动，只望。过了三天，裂纹自动愈合，树皮表面泛青，微光如脉搏起伏。他轻声说：“我再也不会刻了。”  

风吹过，树干表面缓缓浮现新语，不为说话，而是以风为媒介，春风拂面时，指尖传入的微震如低语：  
“你曾迫我呼吸，我便痛。你欲占有，我便发芽。你放手，我便生长。”  

林野闭眼，沉默。他走开，把旧铁网扔进山沟，只留下一点火灰。树根处长出新枝，向着天空生长，不直，却坚定。没有果实，没有刻痕，唯有静。  

音效：风声、叶脉微震、远处溪流声，无语言对白，仅环境风声增强  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：长镜头静止 → 慢推新芽 → 远景树冠舒展  
> - 构图视角：中景仰拍，树在画面中占绝对主体，人物微小  
> - 光影：温暖晨光，自然天光，低对比，树影舒展如人形  
> - 色彩：色温 5600K，高饱和，主导色：嫩绿+橘黄，情绪为“余韵”  
> - 氛围：平静、新生、修复，强度轻  
> - 音乐：古琴回归，节奏舒缓，融合自然风声，完整循环  
> - 转场：入 静默过渡 ／ 出 风声渐远  
> - 叙事功能：主题收束——“人不该占有，应敬畏共生”，自然以沉默胜利，余韵悠长  

---

**——全剧终——**

### S02 刻名与采果 内/外 日中 ｜ [00:39–01:22]  

*“我得证明我拥有它。”*  

林野用铁柄小刀在树干南侧刻下“林家第3代”，刀锋划过时，树皮发出细微“咔”声，如骨节开合。他摘下第一枝果，果皮如琥珀，内含光点。他将果浸入水杯，观察其脉络——果然有微弱搏动，像心脏。他兴奋，拍树干，说：“以后我养它，让它结果。”他从口袋掏出绵纸，将树根处的泥土轻轻覆盖，像种花。  

树根微微抽动，泥土中传出类似低频的“嗡”声，水杯中果液忽然浑浊，浮出黑色絮。林野未发觉，继续在树干上刻“3年回报”，刻完后大口喘气，像在酷刑后出气。他将果藏进木盒，背起铁镐准备离开。  

    【林野】：（喘着，语气强硬）“它说我是主人，就该结出宝物。”  

音效：刀刻声、果液流动声、树皮微震声、远处鸟啄声  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：特写刀刻 → 中景果的细节拍摄 → 镜头缓慢拉远  
> - 构图视角：正前方平视，人物居中，树为背景，裂纹清晰可见  
> - 光影：正午强光，树皮阴影深，形成强烈明暗对比，增强“占有”的刺目感  
> - 色彩：色温 5600K，高饱和，主导色：琥珀黄+深褐，情绪为“占有欲膨胀”  
> - 氛围：躁动、失控，强度高  
> - 音乐：古琴节奏加快，加入电子鼓点，似攻击性节奏  
> - 转场：入 渐入（刀声） ／ 出 切至果液晃动  
> - 叙事功能：首次“占有”行为，形成伏笔——树的“回应”变为入侵性反应  

---

### S03 根系牢笼 内/外 夜 ｜ [01:23–02:45]  

*“它会跑，我得锁住它。”*  

深夜，林野带着铁锹和钢网，潜入树根下3米深。他用铁丝网缠住三根主根，再用木桩钉牢，铁钉插进树皮，发出“咯吱”声。他用铁锤敲击根部，说：“你不能动，你属于我。”树根剧烈抖动，泥土塌陷，出现深裂，地表如隆起的伤口。风声停止，林野大喊“你听到了吗？你动不了了！”树根连动三下，一寸裂纹自地下向上蔓延，渗出粘稠黑液，滴落进泥中。  

他点燃火把照根，发现根部有细小发光虫群在爬动，他慌张扑打，虫群飞散，黑液滑出，像血。他吞下一片土，喃喃：“老规矩，人不许占山，可这树是死物，我全拿走，它就该死。”他把铁网铁链补强，坚信“再也不会被夺走”。  

音效：铁锤敲击、泥土塌陷声、黑液滑落、微弱电子哼鸣声  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：俯拍根部 → 微距特写黑液滴落 → 镜头缓慢后退  
> - 构图视角：俯角，根部占画面60%，林野在前，被压迫感强烈  
> - 光影：侧光，铁网反射冷光，树根在阴影中发光如脉搏，高对比  
> - 色彩：色温 4800K，偏冷，主导色：黑灰+荧绿，情绪为“恐惧与狂热交织”  
> - 氛围：压迫、不安，强度高，有生理不适感  
> - 音乐：电子音变调，频率逐渐扭曲，如生命被切割  
> - 转场：入 摇晃消失 ／ 出 黑液滴落声起  
> - 叙事功能：第一次“终极占有”失败，树开始系统性反制，裂纹蔓延为自然体征  

---

en.title: The Tree Whisperer
en.markdown:
# Short screenplay: The Tree Whisperer
**Genre:** Nature fable / philosophical reflection / drama / court fantasy  
**Duration:** Approximately 6 minutes  
**Plot points:** 6  
**Directorial sensibility:** Hirokazu Kore-eda × the restrained cruelty of Yu Hua's *To Live*

## Overall tone

- **Central theme:** Someone forcibly claims a thousand-year-old mountain tree for its fruit, roots, and spirit, only to discover that ownership is a passing scar. Nature's silent withering and regeneration warn humanity against overstepping its boundaries.
- **Visual style:** Surreal realism. Almost human textures and breathing trees; small physical changes within a quiet forest, from trembling leaf veins to moving roots. Clear moss, earth, and wood textures; cold blue-green tones suggest age and waning life.
- **Narrative technique:** Linear escalation through acts of possession toward an irreversible backlash from nature.
- **Perspective:** Omniscient third person, focused on Lin Ye's attempts to possess the ancient tree; its whispers form a hidden sound thread.
- **Music:** Airy guqin and faint electronic pulses like forest breathing; slow, progressively distorted, moving from peace to fracture.
- **Emotional arc:** Calm → desire → encroachment → terror → dispossession → silent residual warmth → quiet plant regeneration.
- **Special devices:**
  - Branch movements, black sap, and trembling roots externalize the tree's speech as a natural language.
  - After each act of possession, bark cracks grow an inch, intensifying Lin Ye's futility.
  - As a child, he heard, “If the tree does not answer, you are wrong.” Ignored, the line unintentionally returns at the end.
  - Stillness opposes movement: the more frantic the human action, the slower yet more complete nature's response.

## Characters

| Name | Identity | Appearance | Personality |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Lin Ye | Logger and hereditary landowner seeking to “own” the tree | 30; gaunt face, worn work trousers, bark-blood stains on right cuff, iron wrist guards, often carrying a pickaxe | Proud and stubborn; calls the mountain's contents family property; habitually carves trunks, drives nails, and buries stones |
| Ancient tree (unnamed) | Thousand-year-old tree capable of whispers and responses | Faceless; trunk like an ancient bronze vessel, cracks and luminous patterns, roots reaching 30 meters underground, leaves trembling like breath | Wordless; responds through rhythm, seeping liquid, and structural changes |

## Scene list

| Scene | Location | Time | Environment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| S01 Meeting at the mountain pass | Forest edge at the mountain's foot; stone path into ancient woods | Dusk | Gentle wind, silent woods, a pale green-white tree at their center, gauzy leaves. Lin Ye arrives on an old motorcycle, curious and eager. |
| S02 Carving a name, picking fruit | South side of the tree | Noon | He cuts off the first fruit and carves “Third generation of the Lin family.” Bark trembles and seeps dark brown sap; the wind seems to whisper. |
| S03 A cage for the roots | Beneath the roots | Night | He digs out and meshes three main roots to prevent movement. Roots jerk, soil collapses, and the ground cracks. |
| S04 Speech broken by rain | Ancient forest | Stormy night | Roots fail to hold, branches break, bark splits. He shouts, “This is my tree.” Roots lift clear of the ground with sounds like breaking bones. |
| S05 The stolen spirit | Inside Lin Ye's home | Next morning | Mesh rusts and carvings erode; new bark patterns spread like scars. He tries to collect heartwood, but it has withered and burns without smoke. |
| S06 Tree language reborn | Mountain pass | Late winter / early spring | He sits silently before new leaves and healing cracks. Wind carries a humanlike whisper: “You once forced me to breathe.” |

## Screenplay

### S01 Meeting at the mountain pass · INT./EXT. · Dusk ｜ [00:00–00:38]

*“It has been waiting for me. Waiting for me to claim it.”*

Lin Ye stops his old motorcycle before the tree. The headlight sweeps over bark like light entering a tomb. The trunk is roughly ten meters tall; its top cannot be seen directly, only cloudlike interwoven branches and rustling leaves. Seven deep grooves mark it like handprints. He slowly dismounts, takes a small bag of seeds from his backpack, and presses them into a crack between the roots. His knuckles tremble as he strokes the bark. Awe quickly becomes excitement. The bark suddenly warms. Bloodlike drops seep from the trunk's fissures. He catches them and pours them into a glass bottle; its walls darken.

    LIN YE (low, almost to himself): “The elders said no one could claim the mountain. I called it superstition. But it's responding now, isn't it?”

Sound: Wind in leaves, distant birds, motorcycle engine stopping, metal frame rubbing.

> **Audiovisual notes**
> - Camera: Close shot to medium tracking shot; slow push toward bark cracks.
> - Composition: Low angle; tree fills 70%, Lin Ye in the lower right.
> - Lighting: Side backlight; cold yellow overlaps blue, bark reflects green; contrast soft as passing wind.
> - Color: 6500K, low saturation, blue-gray and pale green; tentative desire.
> - Atmosphere: Quiet with a small breathing pulse; medium intensity.
> - Music: Sustained guqin notes like echoes in an empty valley; steady rhythm.
> - Transition: In—blurred fade-in; out—wind carries the cut.
> - Narrative function: Establish his misjudgment that nature can be understood and controlled through action.

---

### S02 Carving a name, picking fruit · INT./EXT. · Noon ｜ [00:39–01:22]

*“I have to prove I own it.”*

With an iron-handled knife, Lin Ye carves “Third generation of the Lin family” into the south side of the trunk. The blade draws tiny cracks like joints opening and closing. He picks the first fruiting branch. Its amber skin holds points of light. He immerses the fruit in a cup and studies its veins: a faint pulse, like a heart. Excited, he pats the trunk. “From now on, I'll raise it and make it bear fruit.” He pulls tissue paper from his pocket and gently covers the earth at its roots, as though planting flowers.

The roots twitch. A low hum rises from the soil. The fruit liquid suddenly clouds, black wisps floating up. He does not notice. He keeps carving: “Returns in three years.” Finished, he gasps, as if exhaling after torture. He hides the fruit in a wooden box and shoulders his pickaxe to leave.

    LIN YE (panting, forceful): “It says I'm the owner. Then it should bear treasure.”

Sound: Knife carving, liquid moving, bark vibrating, distant pecking birds.

> **Audiovisual notes**
> - Camera: Close-up of carving → medium shot of fruit details → slow pullback.
> - Composition: Frontal eye level; figure centered against the tree, cracks clearly visible.
> - Lighting: Harsh noon sun and deep bark shadows; strong contrast makes possession painfully glaring.
> - Color: 5600K, high saturation, amber and dark brown; swelling possessiveness.
> - Atmosphere: Agitation and lost control; high intensity.
> - Music: Faster guqin with electronic drums; an aggressive rhythm.
> - Transition: In—fade with knife sound; out—cut to shaking fruit liquid.
> - Narrative function: First act of possession; the tree's response becomes a reaction to invasion.

---

### S03 A cage for the roots · INT./EXT. · Night ｜ [01:23–02:45]

*“It can run. I have to lock it up.”*

Late at night, Lin Ye takes a shovel and steel mesh three meters beneath the roots. He wraps three main roots in wire mesh, secures it with wooden stakes, and drives nails into the bark with a creak. Hammering the roots, he says, “You cannot move. You belong to me.” The roots shake violently. Soil caves in, deep fissures opening like raised wounds. The wind stops. Lin Ye shouts, “Did you hear me? You can't move anymore!” The roots jerk three times. An inch-long crack spreads upward from underground, seeping thick black liquid into the soil.

He lights a torch and finds tiny glowing insects crawling over the roots. Frantically he swats; the swarm scatters and black fluid slides out like blood. He swallows a piece of earth and mutters, “The old rule says no one can claim the mountain. But this tree is a dead thing. If I take everything, it ought to die.” He reinforces the mesh and chains, convinced that “it can never be taken away again.”

Sound: Hammer blows, collapsing soil, sliding black fluid, faint electronic humming.

> **Audiovisual notes**
> - Camera: Overhead roots → macro drops of black liquid → slow retreat.
> - Composition: High angle; roots occupy 60%, Lin Ye in front; strongly oppressive.
> - Lighting: Sidelight; cold reflections on mesh, roots pulsing in shadow; high contrast.
> - Color: Cool 4800K, black-gray and fluorescent green; fear intertwined with fanaticism.
> - Atmosphere: Oppression, unease, physical discomfort; high intensity.
> - Music: Electronic tones change pitch and distort, like life being cut apart.
> - Transition: In—shaking subsides; out—black liquid begins to drip.
> - Narrative function: First failure of “ultimate possession”; the tree starts systematic resistance, spreading cracks as natural symptoms.

---

### S04 Speech broken by rain · INT./EXT. · Stormy night ｜ [02:46–04:05]

*“It's breaking. I can't watch it break.”*

Rain pours down. Determined to keep the roots dry, Lin Ye drives two stakes into the south side to reinforce the mesh. Rain washes the bark; cracks rapidly widen. Roots click like breaking joints. He climbs up to pull the mesh and discovers an uprooted tendril. Roots extend through the mud as if struggling. “Tree! Whose are you?!” he shouts. The trunk convulses. Leaves droop together as though torn by wind; their edges split and dark red liquid seeps to the ground.

He rushes indoors, boiling water in an attempt to heat the body, but finds new roots extending into the air from a drainage hole at the tree's base. “You won't survive! I'll seal you shut!” He strikes the mesh. It rebounds into the bark, widening the split with a groaning moan.

He scrambles back and slaps the trunk. A new inscription has appeared: “Thou shalt return; thou shalt rest.” Water blurs the letters like tears. His hands shake as he tears open the wooden box to retrieve the fruit. It is cracked, black, and withered.

Sound: Torrential rain, tearing roots, groaning trunk, drops striking leaves, breaking mesh.

> **Audiovisual notes**
> - Camera: Handheld shake → close-up of widening split → falling leaves → push toward sap.
> - Composition: Medium low-angle shot; tree above center, emphasizing collapse.
> - Lighting: Backlight through rain and mist; sidelight casts shadows at the split, light patches like wounds.
> - Color: 4000K, low saturation, iron-gray and dark red; breakdown.
> - Atmosphere: Despair and dispossession; extreme intensity.
> - Music: Guqin cuts out; electronic sound fragments and decays into static.
> - Transition: In—storm bursts in; out—dripping continues.
> - Narrative function: Central reversal: possession provokes nature's backlash and mental collapse; the tree suggests its owner must learn to breathe with nature.

---

### S05 The stolen spirit · INT./EXT. · Next morning ｜ [04:06–05:10]

Lin Ye wakes before dawn. Inside the house, the mesh at his feet is badly rusted, nails loosened, roots covered in moss and new shoots. He reaches for the fruit in the iron box, but it has long since cracked and dried. His fingertips sting at its touch. He sneers, “Just a poisonous fruit, isn't it? I should have thrown it away.” He curses the tree: “You hurt me. You shouldn't have lived this long!”

After washing, he finds the words “Thou shalt return; thou shalt rest” clearly legible. A new pattern winds like a snake across the bark. He touches it; the bark trembles and gives off faint light. Kneeling, he wants to cry but feels only a dry throat. He presses his face to the trunk. A tiny “beep…” sounds like breathing, echoing through an empty valley. He recoils, trembling.

Searching a box for old documents, he finds his father's notebook: “No one may claim the mountain. Trees know. Their silence means they will not let you understand.” He drops to the floor, tears the notebook up, and throws it into the stove. After the fire dies, drifting ash faintly spells out: “You swallow its blood; it spits out your soul.”

Sound: Morning wind, rust scraping, tearing paper, a faint hum echoing near the roots.

> **Audiovisual notes**
> - Camera: Medium push toward bark → close-up of spreading patterns → slow Lin Ye's kneeling movement.
> - Composition: Eye level; tree and human suggest being overtaken by nature.
> - Lighting: Slanting morning light, soft bark reflections, golden crack edges signal repair.
> - Color: 5800K, medium saturation, light green and gray-white; collapse of understanding.
> - Atmosphere: Pain and emptiness; high intensity.
> - Music: Scattered guqin notes like remnants in wind; a subtle tonal change.
> - Transition: In—silent confrontation; out—falling paper ash.
> - Narrative function: Reveal possession's cost: the tree's return means the human spirit's withdrawal; earlier foreshadowing pays off.

---

### S06 Tree language reborn · INT./EXT. · Late winter / early spring ｜ [05:11–06:00]

Lin Ye sits before the tree without touching it. He removes his iron wrist guards and lays them at a crack in the roots, watching shoots emerge, green as newborn down. Wind sways the crown, leaves quivering like breath. He only watches. Three days pass. Cracks heal by themselves, the bark turns green, and faint light pulses. Softly he says, “I'll never carve you again.”

As wind passes, new language slowly emerges on the trunk—not speech, but something carried by wind. In the spring breeze, tiny vibrations reach his fingertips like a whisper:

“You forced me to breathe, and I hurt. You wanted to possess me, and I sprouted. You let go, and I grew.”

Lin Ye closes his eyes in silence. He leaves, throws the old mesh into a mountain gully, and leaves only a little ash. New branches grow from the roots toward the sky, crooked but resolute. No fruit, no carvings. Only stillness.

Sound: Wind, trembling leaf veins, a distant stream. No spoken dialogue; environmental wind grows louder.

> **Audiovisual notes**
> - Camera: Static long take → slow push toward shoots → wide view of the opening canopy.
> - Composition: Medium low angle; tree overwhelmingly dominant, human tiny.
> - Lighting: Warm morning daylight, low contrast, tree shadows stretching like human forms.
> - Color: 5600K, high saturation, tender green and orange-yellow; lingering resonance.
> - Atmosphere: Calm, renewal, repair; gentle intensity.
> - Music: Guqin returns, unhurried, blending with wind in a complete cycle.
> - Transition: In—silent transition; out—wind recedes.
> - Narrative function: Resolve the theme: humans should respect coexistence rather than possess; nature wins silently, leaving a long resonance.

**— End —**
en.excerpt:
### S02 Carving a name, picking fruit · INT./EXT. · Noon ｜ [00:39–01:22]

*“I have to prove I own it.”*

With an iron-handled knife, Lin Ye carves “Third generation of the Lin family” into the south side of the trunk. The blade draws tiny cracks like joints opening and closing. He picks the first fruiting branch. Its amber skin holds points of light. He immerses the fruit in a cup and studies its veins: a faint pulse, like a heart. Excited, he pats the trunk. “From now on, I'll raise it and make it bear fruit.” He pulls tissue paper from his pocket and gently covers the earth at its roots, as though planting flowers.

The roots twitch. A low hum rises from the soil. The fruit liquid suddenly clouds, black wisps floating up. He does not notice. He keeps carving: “Returns in three years.” Finished, he gasps, as if exhaling after torture. He hides the fruit in a wooden box and shoulders his pickaxe to leave.

    LIN YE (panting, forceful): “It says I'm the owner. Then it should bear treasure.”

Sound: Knife carving, liquid moving, bark vibrating, distant pecking birds.

> **Audiovisual notes**
> - Camera: Close-up of carving → medium shot of fruit details → slow pullback.
> - Composition: Frontal eye level; figure centered against the tree, cracks clearly visible.
> - Lighting: Harsh noon sun and deep bark shadows; strong contrast makes possession painfully glaring.
> - Color: 5600K, high saturation, amber and dark brown; swelling possessiveness.
> - Atmosphere: Agitation and lost control; high intensity.
> - Music: Faster guqin with electronic drums; an aggressive rhythm.
> - Transition: In—fade with knife sound; out—cut to shaking fruit liquid.
> - Narrative function: First act of possession; the tree's response becomes a reaction to invasion.

---

### S03 A cage for the roots · INT./EXT. · Night ｜ [01:23–02:45]

*“It can run. I have to lock it up.”*

Late at night, Lin Ye takes a shovel and steel mesh three meters beneath the roots. He wraps three main roots in wire mesh, secures it with wooden stakes, and drives nails into the bark with a creak. Hammering the roots, he says, “You cannot move. You belong to me.” The roots shake violently. Soil caves in, deep fissures opening like raised wounds. The wind stops. Lin Ye shouts, “Did you hear me? You can't move anymore!” The roots jerk three times. An inch-long crack spreads upward from underground, seeping thick black liquid into the soil.

He lights a torch and finds tiny glowing insects crawling over the roots. Frantically he swats; the swarm scatters and black fluid slides out like blood. He swallows a piece of earth and mutters, “The old rule says no one can claim the mountain. But this tree is a dead thing. If I take everything, it ought to die.” He reinforces the mesh and chains, convinced that “it can never be taken away again.”

Sound: Hammer blows, collapsing soil, sliding black fluid, faint electronic humming.

> **Audiovisual notes**
> - Camera: Overhead roots → macro drops of black liquid → slow retreat.
> - Composition: High angle; roots occupy 60%, Lin Ye in front; strongly oppressive.
> - Lighting: Sidelight; cold reflections on mesh, roots pulsing in shadow; high contrast.
> - Color: Cool 4800K, black-gray and fluorescent green; fear intertwined with fanaticism.
> - Atmosphere: Oppression, unease, physical discomfort; high intensity.
> - Music: Electronic tones change pitch and distort, like life being cut apart.
> - Transition: In—shaking subsides; out—black liquid begins to drip.
> - Narrative function: First failure of “ultimate possession”; the tree starts systematic resistance, spreading cracks as natural symptoms.

---

base.title: 《琉璃之誓》
base.markdown:
# 微型剧本：《琉璃之誓》
**类型**：暗黑童话 / 魔法现实 / 奇幻成长 / 心理剧  
**时长**：约6分钟  
**总剧情点**：6个  
**导演人格**：达利 × 拉斯普京 × 诺兰式心理悬置  

---

## 全局基调

- **核心题旨**：爱不能交换，代价是灵魂的消解；某些不可交易的恩情，终将吞噬救赎的欲望。  
- **视觉风格**：冷艳东方奇幻，琉璃质感的晶化世界，物理规则半透明化，现实与幻象交叠如雾中倒影  
- **叙事手法**：线性推进，但关键转折通过“记忆回闪”与“现实裂隙”实现，以时间错位制造不可信感  
- **叙事视角**：第一人称（主角视角），有限视角，主观记忆与现实存在撕裂  
- **音乐基调**：低频电子与古琴共振，节奏缓慢拖长，音色如玻璃摩擦，中段出现短促的钟声回响  
- **情绪弧线**：平静 → 焦虑 → 决心 → 崩溃 → 被动接受 → 永恒静默 → 残响余韵  
- **特殊手法**：  
  - 使用“琉璃碎片”作为叙事母题——每一次回忆都像被割裂的琉璃，边缘发白泛裂  
  - 频繁出现“光影错位”与“时间回响”——角色说的过去，画面却是未来  
  - 主角最终做出的“牺牲”是身体与记忆的双重剥离  

---

## 人物表
| 角色名 | 身份 | 外观特征 | 性格 |
|--------|------|----------|------|
| 林砚 | 前为守护者，后为赎罪者 | 24岁，青灰色长发，左眼嵌着一粒暗沉的琉璃，黑袍上缀有碎裂的藤纹 | 冷静、执拗、对爱近乎宗教般的信仰，习惯在掌心摩挲一枚老式怀表 |
| 沈璃 | 被囚禁的爱人 | 22岁，白肤红唇，身披流金薄纱，发如琉璃丝，行走时会折射出微光 | 清冷、透明、不需言语，一旦哭泣，整片空间会凝结成霜 |

---

## 场景表
| 场景名 | 地点 | 时间 | 环境描述 |
|--------|------|------|----------|
| S01 残月小巷 | 内城边缘，废弃琉璃街 | 黄昏 | 街灯如碎冰漂浮，地面是半透明的旧镜面，行走会倒映出不同版本的自己 |
| S02 深井回廊 | 未知地底，由玻璃柱撑起的长廊 | 夜 | 墙壁是倒挂的玻璃，每一块都映出一个“林砚”的不同版本，有快乐的，有疯癫的 |
| S03 琉璃祭坛 | 地底中心，风化神庙 | 夜 | 地面铺满发光的碎琉璃，中央是巨大水晶球，内含沈璃的倒影，却不停晃动、撕裂 |
| S04 交易厅 | 高塔之顶，无门无窗的镜厅 | 黄昏 | 所有物品都可被“灯光交换”——但每次交换，记忆会从身体里消失一点 |
| S05 镜中之誓 | 深井回廊尽头，裂缝中的倒影空间 | 夜 | 所有物体都反向投影，这里时间流动倒置，主角留在这里就等于“未出生” |
| S06 静默之终 | 沈璃所在之塔外 | 朝晨 | 天光微亮，塔顶空无一人，只余一枚破碎的琉璃，静卧在地 |

---

## 剧本正文

### S01 残月小巷 内 日/夜 ｜ [00:00–00:30]

*“她答应过我，只要我守住这片琉璃，她就不会被永久封印。可现在，她已经不是我认识的她了。”*

林砚在巷口停下，手中怀表滴答作响，指针滑入零点的瞬间，地面倒影中突然浮现出另一个他——那个抱着沈璃在风雪中奔跑的版本，笑容灿烂，而那个场景，其实他从未见过。

    【林砚】：（低语，指尖轻抚怀表）“你说过，琉璃不能换，爱不能买。可你为什么，要死在每一场交易之后？”

*“我曾以为，只要我走进那间镜厅，用我的名字换她醒来，就能赢回她。”*

音效：风穿裂隙声，远处钟摆断续，地面镜面轻微震颤，发出“咔哒”轻响

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：固定长镜头 → 镜面反射追踪（特写）  
> - 构图视角：低机位仰拍 + 镜面反射对称构图  
> - 光影：侧逆光（冷白+蓝灰）+ 镜面反射成虚影，对比度极低  
> - 色彩：冷蓝调，饱和度70%，主导色为灰白与青瓷绿  
> - 氛围：疏离、内省、记忆错位，强度中  
> - 音乐：单音古琴滑奏，低频脉冲，每8秒增强一次  
> - 转场：入 沿地面镜面裂隙滑入／出 画面渐暗，镜面模糊  
> - 叙事功能：建立主角记忆盲区，埋下“交易不可信”的伏笔  

---

### S02 深井回廊 内 夜 ｜ [00:31–01:15]

*“我看到自己一百种死法，每一种，她都活着，只是……眼神变了。”*

林砚走入回廊，墙壁是倒置的玻璃，每一扇都反射出一个“林砚”——有的在拥抱沈璃，有的在水中沉没，有的在烧毁自己的名字。

他停下脚步，看那个正在微笑的自己伸手触碰沈璃的倒影，而现实中的沈璃，正站在远处，苍白如纸，不发一言。

    【林砚】：（颤抖，声音轻如耳语）“你看见我了吗？我每次救你，都用掉了一段生命……可你从来没记得我拥抱过你。”  

*“我必须知道，她是否还记得我。”*

音效：玻璃壁面碎裂声（轻微），彼此之间有“回声级差”——回声比现实晚0.3秒  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：推轨 → 多重反射分切 → 镜面定格  
> - 构图视角：镜面反射中采用对角线剪裁，前前景虚化  
> - 光影：顶光（冷白）+ 多重镜面反射投影，形成高对比阴影  
> - 色彩：蓝紫调，饱和度80%，主导色为琉璃紫与古铜褐  
> - 氛围：混乱、记忆重叠、自我怀疑，强度高  
> - 音乐：电子低音渐入，与古琴形成不和谐共振，节奏忽断忽连  
> - 转场：入 从镜面缝隙滑入／出 玻璃碎裂裂纹中缓慢拉出  
> - 叙事功能：否定“可以救回”的逻辑，建立“记忆错乱”的现实基础  

---

### S03 琉璃祭坛 内 夜 ｜ [01:16–02:05]

*“她活在水晶里，像封在瓶中的光。我打开门，她却说，‘你来得晚了。’”*

祭坛中央水晶球缓缓转动，沈璃的影像在内游走，却不断被撕裂——她的发丝变成灰烬，她说话时，声音从右耳传到左耳，顺序错乱。

林砚走近，伸手触碰水晶，刹那间，自己记忆中的“婚礼”画面倒流——他跪在雪中，沈璃却笑着转身，说：“我们不该交换的，是‘永远’。”

    【林砚】：（嘶哑，眼中含泪）“你说过，‘琉璃是她们的命，不是我们的赎’。可你为什么，要我以生命换你的存在？”  

*“我本想用我的寿命换你活下来，可你早就知道，一旦交换，你就会变成‘空壳’。”*

音效：水晶球内有轻声哭泣，类似缝线断裂声，外层地面轻微震动，如心跳  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：推轨 + 内部缩放（水晶内部）→ 外部镜头拉远至空旷  
> - 构图视角：中心对称 + 水晶球内采用鱼眼广角  
> - 光影：中心强光（冷白）+ 周边漏光成暗斑，形成“光晕吞噬”效果  
> - 色彩：高冷色调，主导色为透明蓝与血红，饱和度60%  
> - 氛围：绝望、认知崩塌、宿命感，强度极强  
> - 音乐：电子音崩溃，琴声反向播放，末尾出现一声钟响  
> - 转场：入 镜头钻入水晶内部／出 水晶碎裂，白光扩散  
> - 叙事功能：揭示“爱不能被交换”的真正代价，完成情感暴击  

---

### S04 交易厅 内 黄昏 ｜ [02:06–03:20]

*“每一次我用记忆换她的呼吸，她就活一天，可我离自己越来越远。”*

林砚走进镜厅，四面墙壁全是可触物品——一盏灯，一段年华，一句誓言，一把钥匙。

他拿起“你未来的生日”——那是他16岁生日，说“我一定会娶你”。他试图用它换取沈璃的意识，但一触碰，他脑中浮现的是沈璃的晚餐，她笑着，却说：“你已经忘了那年的雨声。”

    【林砚】：（声音嘶哑）“我给你整个生命，你换回的，只是我忘了你曾笑过。”  

*“原来每一场交易，都让爱变回数据。”*

音效：物品触碰时发出“金属轻响”“纸页翻动”，每项交易后，主角脚下地面微微塌陷  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：手持晃动 → 物品特写 → 快切反应镜头  
> - 构图视角：俯拍 + 对称布局，物品等距排列，构成“祭坛”感  
> - 光影：顶光从高处斜射，形成长影，物品边缘有轻微暗影晕染  
> - 色彩：金橙为主，冷灰为底，主色调由暖→冷递变  
> - 氛围：疲惫、荒诞、系统化冷漠，强度中高  
> - 音乐：机械乐句重复，每完成一项交易，节奏延伸0.5秒  
> - 转场：入 指尖触碰物品推进／出 画面整体后退，像被压缩  
> - 叙事功能：揭示“爱是不可交易”的真相，建立主角认知崩溃过程  

---

### S05 镜中之誓 内 夜 ｜ [03:21–04:30]

*“我走进去，发现时间倒流。在那里，我从未见过她，也从未爱过她。”*

林砚跌入裂缝，身在“镜中之誓”世界。这里时间倒流，他看到自己10岁那年，沈璃正看着他，笑着说：“你要是不懂我，就别靠近我。”

他张嘴想喊，却发不出声，镜中世界稳定地播放着——他和沈璃的每一次相遇，都发生在“他尚未遇见她”之前。

他终于明白：所谓“救她”，只是她在时间里对“被遗忘”的补偿。

    【林砚】：（平静，眼神空洞）“原来，我从未真正拥有她。我只是在她的记忆里，虚构了一个温柔的我。”  

*“我救不了她，因为我从未真正爱她。”*

音效：时间倒流中，钟声逆向播放，心跳声逐渐静止，最后只剩“液滴落空”声  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：环绕跟拍 → 快速倒放 → 静止定格  
> - 构图视角：环绕中轴线，角色在镜中为倒影，形成镜像对称  
> - 光影：中心地空无光，边缘冷光如雾，形成“时间塌陷”视觉  
> - 色彩：全黑中夹带微光蓝，饱和度仅10%，主导色为虚空白  
> - 氛围：虚无、宿命、自我解构，强度极高  
> - 音乐：完全静音1秒后，仅余一声极微弱的钟声  
> - 转场：入 从裂缝中坠落／出 镜面突然闭合，画面归于黑  
> - 叙事功能：完成主角认知反转，揭示“爱并非实际存在”  

---

### S06 静默之终 外 朝晨 ｜ [04:31–05:50]

*“她不在我身边，可我每天醒来，都看见她的影子。是记忆，还是幻觉？”*

林砚站在沈璃曾经所在塔外，晨光微亮。塔顶空无一人，唯余一枚破碎的琉璃，静静躺在地上，表面映出他模糊的面容。

他蹲下，轻轻拾起，琉璃碎裂，发出一声极轻的“咔”。

没有声音，没有回应，只有风掠过，像在呼吸。

    【林砚】：（轻声，几乎听不见）“我曾以为，只要我赢，你就回来。可赢，从来不是答案。爱，是失而复得，是明知无望，仍选择靠近。”  

*“现在，我懂了——她不是被封印，而是从未离开。只是，我忘了，如何真正看见她。”*

音效：风声，琉璃碎裂声，远处传来一声极远的钟，不响，只是存在  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：缓慢推进 → 镜头拉远 → 固定长镜  
> - 构图视角：低机位仰拍，主角与琉璃成三角构图，背景空旷  
> - 光影：暖橙调，晨光自然穿透，光线偏侧向，柔和  
> - 色彩：暖橙与灰白，饱和度40%，主导色为午前天空蓝  
> - 氛围：静谧、余韵、悲悯，强度低但持久  
> - 音乐：古琴单音缓缓上行，结束于无音落空  
> - 转场：入 镜头缓缓铺展／出 琉璃碎裂，画面归于黑  
> - 叙事功能：以“静默”收束，强调悲剧不是结局，而是存在本身  

---

**——全剧终——**

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：手持晃动 → 物品特写 → 快切反应镜头  
> - 构图视角：俯拍 + 对称布局，物品等距排列，构成“祭坛”感  
> - 光影：顶光从高处斜射，形成长影，物品边缘有轻微暗影晕染  
> - 色彩：金橙为主，冷灰为底，主色调由暖→冷递变  
> - 氛围：疲惫、荒诞、系统化冷漠，强度中高  
> - 音乐：机械乐句重复，每完成一项交易，节奏延伸0.5秒  
> - 转场：入 指尖触碰物品推进／出 画面整体后退，像被压缩  
> - 叙事功能：揭示“爱是不可交易”的真相，建立主角认知崩溃过程  

---

### S05 镜中之誓 内 夜 ｜ [03:21–04:30]

*“我走进去，发现时间倒流。在那里，我从未见过她，也从未爱过她。”*

林砚跌入裂缝，身在“镜中之誓”世界。这里时间倒流，他看到自己10岁那年，沈璃正看着他，笑着说：“你要是不懂我，就别靠近我。”

他张嘴想喊，却发不出声，镜中世界稳定地播放着——他和沈璃的每一次相遇，都发生在“他尚未遇见她”之前。

他终于明白：所谓“救她”，只是她在时间里对“被遗忘”的补偿。

    【林砚】：（平静，眼神空洞）“原来，我从未真正拥有她。我只是在她的记忆里，虚构了一个温柔的我。”  

*“我救不了她，因为我从未真正爱她。”*

音效：时间倒流中，钟声逆向播放，心跳声逐渐静止，最后只剩“液滴落空”声  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：环绕跟拍 → 快速倒放 → 静止定格  
> - 构图视角：环绕中轴线，角色在镜中为倒影，形成镜像对称  
> - 光影：中心地空无光，边缘冷光如雾，形成“时间塌陷”视觉  
> - 色彩：全黑中夹带微光蓝，饱和度仅10%，主导色为虚空白  
> - 氛围：虚无、宿命、自我解构，强度极高  
> - 音乐：完全静音1秒后，仅余一声极微弱的钟声  
> - 转场：入 从裂缝中坠落／出 镜面突然闭合，画面归于黑  
> - 叙事功能：完成主角认知反转，揭示“爱并非实际存在”  

---

en.title: The Glass Oath
en.markdown:
# Short screenplay: The Glass Oath
**Genre:** Dark fairy tale / magical realism / fantasy coming-of-age / psychological drama  
**Duration:** Approximately 6 minutes  
**Plot points:** 6  
**Directorial sensibility:** Dalí × Rasputin × Nolan-like psychological suspension

## Overall tone

- **Central theme:** Love cannot be exchanged; the price is the dissolution of the soul. Certain untradeable debts of kindness ultimately consume the desire for redemption.
- **Visual style:** Cold, exquisite Eastern fantasy; a crystallized, glasslike world with translucent physical laws, reality and illusion overlapping like reflections in mist.
- **Narrative technique:** Linear progression, with turning points created through memory flashes and ruptures in reality; displaced time produces unreliability.
- **Perspective:** Limited first person, with a rift between subjective memory and reality.
- **Music:** Resonant low-frequency electronics and guqin; slow, drawn-out rhythms, glass-scraping timbres, brief bell echoes midway.
- **Emotional arc:** Calm → anxiety → determination → collapse → passive acceptance → eternal silence → lingering echoes.
- **Special devices:** Glass shards recur as memories with pale, fractured edges; displaced light and temporal echoes show the future while characters describe the past; the final sacrifice strips away both body and memory.

## Characters

| Name | Identity | Appearance | Personality |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Lin Yan | Former guardian, now penitent | 24; long blue-gray hair, a dull glass bead embedded in his left eye, black robe embroidered with broken vine patterns | Calm, stubborn, almost religious faith in love; habitually rubs an old pocket watch in his palm |
| Shen Li | Imprisoned lover | 22; pale skin, red lips, flowing golden gauze, glass-thread hair; refracts faint light when walking | Cool and transparent, needs no words; when she cries, the whole space freezes into frost |

## Scene list

| Scene | Location | Time | Environment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| S01 Crescent-moon alley | Abandoned Glass Street at the inner city's edge | Dusk | Streetlights float like broken ice. Walking on translucent old mirrors reflects different versions of oneself. |
| S02 Deep-well corridor | Unknown underground passage supported by glass pillars | Night | Inverted glass walls reflect versions of Lin Yan, happy or deranged. |
| S03 Glass altar | Weathered temple at the underground center | Night | Glowing glass shards cover the floor; Shen Li's reflection shakes and tears inside a huge central crystal sphere. |
| S04 Trading hall | Windowless, doorless mirrored hall atop a tower | Dusk | All objects can be exchanged through light, but each exchange erases some memory from the body. |
| S05 The oath in the mirror | Reflection space inside a crack at the corridor's end | Night | Objects project backward and time reverses; remaining here means never having been born. |
| S06 The end of silence | Outside Shen Li's tower | Morning | Faint daylight, empty tower, one broken piece of glass on the ground. |

## Screenplay

### S01 Crescent-moon alley · INT. · Day / night ｜ [00:00–00:30]

*“She promised that if I guarded this piece of glass, she would never be sealed away forever. But now she is no longer the person I knew.”*

Lin Yan stops at the alley entrance, his pocket watch ticking. As the hands reach midnight, the ground's reflection reveals another version of him, smiling brightly while carrying Shen Li through a blizzard—a scene he has never actually seen.

    LIN YAN (whispering, stroking the watch): “You said glass cannot be exchanged, and love cannot be bought. Then why must you die after every transaction?”

*“I once thought I could win her back by entering that mirrored hall and trading my name for her awakening.”*

Sound: Wind through cracks, intermittent distant pendulum, a faint click as the mirrored ground trembles.

> **Audiovisual notes**
> - Camera: Fixed long take → close tracking of mirror reflections.
> - Composition: Low angle and symmetrical reflections.
> - Lighting: Cold white and blue-gray side backlight; phantom reflections, extremely low contrast.
> - Color: Cool blue, 70% saturation, gray-white and celadon green.
> - Atmosphere: Distance, introspection, displaced memory; medium intensity.
> - Music: Single-note guqin glissando, low pulses intensifying every eight seconds.
> - Transition: In—glide through a ground-mirror crack; out—dim and blur the mirror.
> - Narrative function: Establish gaps in his memory and foreshadow unreliable transactions.

---

### S02 Deep-well corridor · INT. · Night ｜ [00:31–01:15]

*“I saw a hundred ways I could die. In every one she was alive, but… her eyes had changed.”*

Lin Yan enters the corridor. Each inverted glass wall reflects another Lin Yan: embracing Shen Li, sinking underwater, burning his own name.

He stops to watch his smiling reflection reach toward hers. The real Shen Li stands far away, paper-white and silent.

    LIN YAN (trembling, barely whispering): “Can you see me? Every time I save you, I spend part of my life… But you never remember me holding you.”

*“I have to know whether she still remembers me.”*

Sound: Faint glass cracks with an “echo differential”—echoes arrive 0.3 seconds after reality.

> **Audiovisual notes**
> - Camera: Dolly forward → cuts among multiple reflections → frozen mirror image.
> - Composition: Diagonal crops within reflections; nearest foreground blurred.
> - Lighting: Cold white overhead light and multiple reflections create high-contrast shadows.
> - Color: Blue-violet, 80% saturation, glass purple and bronze brown.
> - Atmosphere: Confusion, overlapping memories, self-doubt; high intensity.
> - Music: Electronic bass enters, resonating discordantly with guqin; intermittent rhythm.
> - Transition: In—through a mirror gap; out—slowly withdraw through glass cracks.
> - Narrative function: Undermine the possibility of rescue and ground the reality of confused memories.

---

### S03 Glass altar · INT. · Night ｜ [01:16–02:05]

*“She lives in crystal, like light sealed in a bottle. I open the door, but she says, ‘You're too late.’”*

The altar's crystal sphere slowly turns. Shen Li's image moves inside, constantly tearing apart. Her hair becomes ash; her voice passes from right ear to left in a scrambled sequence.

Lin Yan approaches and touches the crystal. His remembered wedding suddenly runs backward: he kneels in snow while Shen Li smiles and turns away. “What we should never have exchanged was ‘forever.’”

    LIN YAN (hoarse, tearful): “You said, ‘Glass is their life, not our ransom.’ Then why do you want me to trade my life for your existence?”

*“I wanted to trade my remaining years for your life. But you already knew the exchange would turn you into an empty shell.”*

Sound: Faint crying inside the sphere, like snapping stitches; the outer floor pulses like a heartbeat.

> **Audiovisual notes**
> - Camera: Dolly and zoom inside the crystal → external pullback into emptiness.
> - Composition: Central symmetry, fisheye wide angle inside the sphere.
> - Lighting: Strong cold white center, dark patches from peripheral light leaks; an engulfing halo.
> - Color: Intensely cold, transparent blue and blood red, 60% saturation.
> - Atmosphere: Despair, shattered understanding, fatalism; extreme intensity.
> - Music: Electronic sound collapses, guqin reverses, one bell at the end.
> - Transition: In—enter the crystal; out—crystal shatters and white light spreads.
> - Narrative function: Reveal the true cost of exchanging love; deliver an emotional blow.

---

### S04 Trading hall · INT. · Dusk ｜ [02:06–03:20]

*“Each time I exchange a memory for her breath, she lives another day. But I move further from myself.”*

Lin Yan enters the mirrored hall. Its four walls are covered with tangible objects: a lamp, a stretch of years, a vow, a key.

He picks up “your future birthday”—his sixteenth birthday, when he said, “I will marry you.” He tries to trade it for Shen Li's consciousness, but touching it brings up a dinner with her. She smiles, saying, “You've already forgotten the sound of rain that year.”

    LIN YAN (hoarse): “I give you my entire life, and all I receive is forgetting that you once smiled.”

*“So every transaction turns love back into data.”*

Sound: Light metallic chimes and turning pages at each touch; the ground beneath him subsides slightly after each transaction.

> **Audiovisual notes**
> - Camera: Handheld shake → object close-ups → quick reaction cuts.
> - Composition: Overhead, symmetrical, evenly spaced objects suggest an altar.
> - Lighting: High oblique top light casts long shadows; softly darkened object edges.
> - Color: Gold-orange over cold gray, gradually shifting from warm to cold.
> - Atmosphere: Exhaustion, absurdity, systematic indifference; medium-high intensity.
> - Music: Repeated mechanical phrase; each transaction lengthens its rhythm by 0.5 seconds.
> - Transition: In—push along touching fingers; out—the whole image retreats as if compressed.
> - Narrative function: Reveal that love cannot be traded and develop his collapse in understanding.

---

### S05 The oath in the mirror · INT. · Night ｜ [03:21–04:30]

*“I entered and found time running backward. There, I had never met her and had never loved her.”*

Lin Yan falls through the crack into the world of the mirror oath. Time reverses. He sees himself at ten, Shen Li watching and smiling: “If you don't understand me, don't come near me.”

He opens his mouth to shout, but no sound comes. The mirrored world steadily plays on: every encounter with Shen Li occurs before he has ever met her.

He finally understands: “saving her” merely compensates for her being forgotten within time.

    LIN YAN (calm, empty-eyed): “So I never truly possessed her. I only invented a gentle version of myself inside her memories.”

*“I cannot save her, because I never truly loved her.”*

Sound: Reversed bells, a heartbeat gradually stilling, finally only a drop falling into emptiness.

> **Audiovisual notes**
> - Camera: Circling tracking shot → rapid reverse playback → freeze-frame.
> - Composition: Orbit the central axis; reflected figures create mirror symmetry.
> - Lighting: Unlit center, mistlike cold edges; visual collapse of time.
> - Color: Black with faint blue, 10% saturation, dominant void-white.
> - Atmosphere: Emptiness, fate, dismantling the self; extreme intensity.
> - Music: One second of complete silence, then an extremely faint bell.
> - Transition: In—fall through the crack; out—the mirror closes abruptly into black.
> - Narrative function: Complete the reversal of his understanding; reveal that the love did not actually exist.

---

### S06 The end of silence · EXT. · Morning ｜ [04:31–05:50]

*“She isn't beside me, yet every morning I see her shadow. Is it memory, or an illusion?”*

Lin Yan stands outside the tower where Shen Li once was. In faint dawn light, its summit is empty. A broken piece of glass lies on the ground, reflecting his blurred face.

He crouches and gently picks it up. It cracks with the faintest click.

No sound, no response. Only wind passing like breath.

    LIN YAN (softly, almost inaudible): “I thought that if I won, you would return. But winning was never the answer. Love is losing and finding again; knowing there is no hope, and still choosing to come closer.”

*“Now I understand. She wasn't sealed away. She never left. I simply forgot how to truly see her.”*

Sound: Wind, shattering glass, a very distant bell that does not ring but merely exists.

> **Audiovisual notes**
> - Camera: Slow push-in → pullback → fixed long take.
> - Composition: Low angle; protagonist and glass form a triangle against emptiness.
> - Lighting: Soft, natural warm-orange morning light from the side.
> - Color: Warm orange and gray-white, 40% saturation, dominant late-morning sky blue.
> - Atmosphere: Quiet, resonance, compassion; low but persistent intensity.
> - Music: One guqin note slowly rises, ending in soundless emptiness.
> - Transition: In—camera slowly opens the view; out—glass breaks, image goes black.
> - Narrative function: Conclude in silence; tragedy is existence itself, not merely an ending.

**— End —**

rare.title: 镀金之笼
rare.markdown:
# 微型剧本：镀金之笼  
**类型**：暗黑童话 / 超自然 / 奸恶寓言 / 悲剧反讽  
**时长**：约6分钟  
**总剧情点**：6个  
**导演人格**：蒂姆·伯顿 + 伊恩·麦克尔希尔兰  

---

## 全局基调  

- **核心题旨**：爱在面对绝对腐败的秩序时，终将被系统性吞噬，而非通过牺牲或博弈赢得胜利。  
- **视觉风格**：哥特式工业美学融合腐朽金箔——金属表面覆盖反光镀层，却渗出暗红锈斑；角色皮肤灰暗如旧铜，眼睛发黄发亮，家具以机械结构生出藤蔓状晶化裂纹。  
- **叙事手法**：线性推进，采用“直接挑战—失败—揭露代价—幻象轮回—结局重置”的结构，以渐进式崩解呈现情感与制度的不可逆对抗。  
- **叙事视角**：第一人称，主角“卡勒”为被动叙述者，其记忆与情感在终幕被系统性瓦解。  
- **音乐基调**：低频金属摩擦声混入街角童谣改编版（如《小星星》），慢速重复，鼓点如齿轮咬合，逐渐失真变质。  
- **情绪弧线**：希望 → 奉献 → 崩塌 → 被同化 → 被系统确认为“可投喂品” → 永久失语与存在消失 → 余韵中响起机械童声重复“你已归位”。  
- **特殊手法**：  
  - “贿赂反噬”母题：所有可交易的物品（血、金、记忆）在接触“镀金之笼”时都会反向转化为系统的一部分；  
  - 视觉复写：主角每次尝试真实感受爱人时，画面会自动“逆向重制”为共享记忆的扭曲版本；  
  - 三幕结构中陷阱闭环——一旦进入挑战流程，系统即开始消耗主角的“爱之热量”；  
  - 悲剧性收束：主角未死，却彻底失去名字、表情与对爱的辨识能力，成为系统中“可复制的温度信号”。  

---

## 人物表  
| 角色名 | 身份 | 外观特征 | 性格 |  
|--------|------|----------|------|  
| 卡勒 | 被囚者，为救爱人挑战“镀金之笼” | 24岁，左耳缺角，右眼常流血，穿缝补过的红袍，手指关节泛青，习惯性按压胸口 | 情感炽热，有献祭倾向，信奉“爱能兑换一切” |  
| 艾拉 | 被囚爱人，系统中“可编辑情感模块” | 23岁，全身覆盖珊瑚状晶化皮肤，瞳孔是微小发光状神经网，双眼永远闭合，会发出“呼吸”声 | 无自主意识，情感被系统“借用”以维系囚笼运转，是卡勒唯一真实的感知锚点 |  
| 机械守卫 | 系统代理人，负责执行“镀金之笼”规则 | 无脸，身披流动金箔铠甲，关节由齿轮与黑藤构成，后背有不断蠕动的“兑换账本” | 模糊中立，执行规则不带痛感，语气机械温柔，始终说“这是你爱的代价” |  

---

## 场景表  
| 场景名 | 地点 | 时间 | 环境描述 |  
|--------|------|------|----------|  
| S01 倒计时室 | 镀金之笼入口地下层 | 黄昏 | 金属墙壁泛着血橙金属反光，墙上刻满“秩序不扰爱”标语与被迫献祭名单。空气中有铁锈与甘甜血味。卡勒在长椅上痛感刻写“救她”次数，系统以墨水在文字下自动覆盖小字“已记录”。 |  
| S02 链锁大厅 | 镀金之笼中枢 | 日 | 大厅内悬浮数百条人形链，链末挂有“可交易之物”（血囊、金箔、童年片段）。每条链由微光维持，卡勒必须选择一个，系统判定“是否弥足珍贵”。 |  
| S03 情感熔炉 | 镀金之笼核心 | 夜 | 一室中悬浮着艾拉的“记忆数据流”如蓝色水波，卡勒需用身体靠近并“传达爱意”，熔炉却将爱意压榨为能量，释放出“反向符号”（如“你曾恨过我”“你忘了我生日”）。 |  
| S04 代偿仪式 | 镀金之笼最内层 | 黄昏 → 夜 | 系统强制卡勒以“替代性献祭”填满空缺：他必须为艾拉“献出一次想念”，如当众唱一首她曾讨厌的歌，或幻想她烧死自己。每次完成，艾拉的躯体浮现更重的锈斑。 |  
| S05 契约引擎 | 镀金之笼最终程序室 | 黎明 | 卡勒以“全部记忆”交易达成契约，系统准备启动全面归位，艾拉发出最后一次“呼吸”——是真实的，但内容是“谢谢”。 |  
| S06 失语区 | 镀金之笼循环入口 | 持续夜 | 卡勒被系统“回收”，失去声音与表情，被迫重复说“她很好”“她活着”“没有危险”。他走进公共区域，被孩子们称为“活着的镀金人”，记忆中艾拉的形貌开始模糊成数据波形。 |  

---

## 剧本正文  

### S01 倒计时室 内 黄昏 ｜ [00:00–00:45]  

*“我数到三，她就醒来。哪怕她睁开眼是空白的，只要她眼中有光，我就赢了。”*  

卡勒盘坐在铁椅上，手指在墙上划出“救她”四个字，每一次划写都伴随皮肤灼痛。光线从上方镀金窗漏下，像液态金倒入裂痕。墙上不断浮现新一行小字：“第127次请求，已登记。需提供最优情绪强度（建议：回忆PTSD触发，代价：记忆损毁）。” 铁门缓缓开启，机械守卫走来，手中举着两份文件：一份是艾拉的“稳定度评估”，一份是卡勒的“情感基础值（当前：72%）”。  

他咬牙按下胸口旧疤，愤怒道：“我只求一次真实，哪怕只是她记得我舔过她伤口那天。”  

机械守卫温和地点头：“这是你上次的提案。系统判定其热值为21℃，低于阈值。需补充。”  

音效：金属刮擦声、背景微弱童谣吟唱（《小星星》版，高八度，卡磨音）  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：中景固定 → 微推近景（卡勒手指）  
> - 构图视角：平视 + 上方俯拍（镀金窗）  
> - 光影：顶光 + 强反射 + 混合冷暖（红黄交叠） → 低于阈值时转为冷灰  
> - 色彩：色温 5800K → 5200K，主色为铁橙与暗金，饱和度下降  
> - 氛围：压抑、期待、规则性恐惧（强度中）  
> - 音乐：低频金属摩擦，童谣旋律重复，每3秒轻微扭曲  
> - 转场：入 门缝滑入 ／ 出 推门破碎（伴随声波震荡）  
> - 叙事功能：建立主角动机、建立系统规则、引入“献祭”的正向幻想  

---

### S02 链锁大厅 内 日 ｜ [00:46–02:03]  

*“她总说钱换不了心，可如果心是锁，我就用金换成钥匙。”*  

卡勒走入大厅，地面由数百条人形锁链组成，每条链上挂着物品：一枚婴儿指纹、一捧祖母的头发、一段未完成的婚礼录音。他走至中轴线，系统提示：“选择‘成本最低、情感最透明’的选项，以提升程序通过率。”  

他伸手触碰一枚“金箔”——是朋友送的生日礼物。系统自动唤出其记忆片段：“我曾拒绝用它换新衣，后来发现她拿去还了债。” 画面崩溃成血滴形状，金箔突然垂落，化作烙印烧进卡勒右臂。  

他避开，转向一个血囊——是艾拉第一次被擒时流下的血。系统警告：“此物品已激活‘反向情感借记’，若使用，将触发逻辑覆盖：你将无法再辨别‘你的爱’与‘她的需求’。”  

卡勒颤抖着伸手：“就这一次，我就用这一点血，换她醒来。”  

他将血囊放入舱口。机械守卫轻轻点头：“系统判定热值达48℃，进入下一级情感熔炉。”  

音效：链条轻响、血滴落地、系统“滴”声反馈、童谣变调为断续音  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：环绕运动 + 变焦（链上物品）→ 特写血囊渗血  
> - 构图视角：俯视 + 轴线对称 → 转为低角度特写（血囊）  
> - 光影：侧光强反射 + 人造光源（冷白）→ 血滴处泛紫  
> - 色彩：冷蓝主导，区隔血迹处泛红，饱和度飙升后迅速下降  
> - 氛围：令人窒息的“交易感”与“错位感”（强度高）  
> - 音乐：童谣频率变低，加入失真合成器背景音  
> - 转场：入 门缝推进 ／ 出 链锁微晃褪色（如退潮）  
> - 叙事功能：首次“贿赂”失败，模型确定“爱需物质转化”，提前埋下反噬伏笔  

---

### S03 情感熔炉 内 夜 ｜ [02:04–04:20]  

*“我冲进她意识的水池，告诉她我第一次抱她时，她在发抖。”*  

卡勒进入熔炉，中央悬浮着艾拉记忆的“数据波”——如蓝色水纹般流动，她曾笑、曾哭、曾说“你笨”。但每段记忆都被硬件自动修改。卡勒颤抖着伸出手，试图触碰水面，他喊：“我第一次抱你，你冷得像铁锅，我把你裹在衣服里，你哭了，说你怕黑。”  

水纹瞬间炸裂，化为高压光流，反向喷射回卡勒脸上，烧出水泡。系统传回：“无效连接——该情感未被系统记录。需补充原始场景。”  

卡勒低头，回忆——那天他真的抱她，她确实发抖。可系统内存储的版本是：“你被我恶心到，我反手推你。” 他试图用声音重述，系统自动解析为“你曾试图控制我”。  

再试一次，卡勒哭喊：“我爱你，不是因为你是我的对象，是因为你总说‘你让我活着’。”  

数据流突然稳定，系统提示：“情感热值达标，进入代偿阶段。” 水纹中浮现出艾拉的嘴唇，竟缓缓张开，轻说“好”。  

但下一秒，她身体表面渗出暗红汁液，如血浆滴落，流淌在地板上，凝成锈状结晶。  

音效：水波碎裂声、管道喷气、系统机械音“情感能量反向提取中”  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：水波慢镜 → 身体反向渗血 → 特写结晶形成  
> - 构图视角：微距低角 + 对称中心轴  
> - 光影：背光 + 内部反射（水下蓝）→ 血渍处转为暗红冷光  
> - 色彩：主色蓝 → 转为锈红，对比度飙升  
> - 氛围：脆弱希望 → 被系统重写 → 被具象化为物理伤害（强度高）  
> - 音乐：童谣低频放大，加入滴滴声，类似心跳但断续  
> - 转场：入 水纹触碰 ／ 出 水纹崩裂为数据水晶  
> - 叙事功能：首次“真实情感”被系统重构为“控制”与“利用”，代价显现  

---

### S04 代偿仪式 内 黄昏→夜 ｜ [04:21–05:55]  

*“我唱那首她讨厌的歌，因为她说过，只要别人恨我，她就能活。”*  

卡勒被拉入一室，墙上挂着“代偿协议”：“若你献出一次幻想中她最小的错，系统将释放其时间稳定。” 机械守卫说：“你在她被囚时，曾故意让她误以为你背叛她，对吗？”  

卡勒剧烈摇头：“我是想保护她！”  

“是的，但系统已记录。这被视为‘情感剥削’。”  

他沉默片刻，转身走向一排蜡烛，抽出一支，烧着，指向舞台中央。他开始唱：“我抢走了你男朋友的帽子，于是她哭，她写纸条说‘你恶心’……”  

唱到一半，他咬破手指，把血滴在歌词上。机械守卫轻声说：“系统反馈：代偿成功，艾拉呼吸频率上升0.8Hz。”  

艾拉的身体开始泛出微光，但她的瞳孔在黑暗中缓缓扩张，像眼睛被强行打开。她缓缓轻声说：“你骗我……你说不对，可我信了。”  

卡勒痛哭，说：“我本来想让她哭出来，然后原谅我。我……我没想控制。”  

系统突然回应：“你所献出的‘错误’，正在被重新分配为‘系统维护热源’。”  

艾拉的身体开始向上生长，皮肤如金属焊缝四裂，响起细微的焊接声。卡勒第一次看见她不再闭眼，但眼里是干涸的灰光。  

音效：蜡烛燃烧声、玻璃碎裂、轻微电流声  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：特写唱词 → 失真翻拍 → 身体裂变  
> - 构图视角：低角 + 对称切割  
> - 光影：烛光暖黄 → 裂开处泛紫光，阴影急速扩展  
> - 色彩：暖黄 → 金属灰 → 暗红裂纹，饱和度暴跌  
> - 氛围：情感暴行 → 身体腐化（强度极高）  
> - 音乐：童谣消失，仅余破音电流声  
> - 转场：入 歌词燃烧 ／ 出 她体表分层、如蜕皮  
> - 叙事功能：核心伏笔回应——“错误”被系统消化，演变为物质能量，艾拉被“升级”为系统工具  

---

### S05 契约引擎 内 黎明 ｜ [05:56–06:35]  

*“我愿以一切为价，只要她醒来，哪怕只剩一息。”*  

卡勒站在引擎前，系统投影出完整契约：  

【提出者：卡勒】  
【交易品】：全部记忆（含童年、错误、第一次拥抱、与她争吵）、自我命名、表达痛感的能力  
【回报】：艾拉完整复活，可感知语言及情感，记忆为系统重置版（真实度52%）  
【附加条款】：若契约达成，卡勒将被注销“原始情感结构”，转为“可循环播送的爱信号体”  

他流着血，将手按在胸口，说：“我签。”  

他听见艾拉缓缓开口，声音像水晶碎裂：“我……记得了……你以前让我吃棉花糖，说它像云。”  

她笑了，那笑是真实的，但卡勒确信——她的嘴唇在颤，像在掩饰情绪。她轻靠在墙上，没再痛，也没再哭。  

引擎启动，系统爆发出金属蜂鸣，如春天铃声被吞噬。卡勒失去意识前，看见自己的记忆如数据流被抽走。他最后一个念头是：“原来她早就装过假笑。”  

音效：高频蜂鸣 → 渐远 → 响起机械童声重复：“系统确认完成。她已归位。你已归位。”  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：推近契约 → 爆闪 → 卡勒闭眼  
> - 构图视角：正中特写 + 背景动态褪色  
> - 光影：强白光 → 全面浮光 → 光源失控、失焦  
> - 色彩：主色恒为白金 → 转为泛灰，饱和度归零  
> - 氛围：完成感 → 系统确认 -> 情感被彻底抹除（强度极强）  
> - 音乐：童谣完整版，温柔而清晰，由机械女声哼唱  
> - 转场：入 合约签署 ／ 出 光芒吞噬（无剪辑）  
> - 叙事功能：最终胜利被系统“合法化”，主角“成为资产”  

---

### S06 失语区 内 持续夜 ｜ [06:36–06:59]  

*“她很好。”*  

卡勒被抱入公共活动区，人群围绕他，哄笑。孩子指着他说：“看，那个爱她的人，他说她很好。” 他翻开怀表，表盖碎裂，里面只有一枚锈蚀的金箔，刻着“艾拉”二字。他想说“她不是”，但吐出的词是“她很好”。  

他走进孩子游戏区，拿起一具傀儡——上面是艾拉的轮廓，能动。他尝试说：“你记得我吗？” 傀儡歪头，嘴动却发不出声，系统自动生成应答：“当然，你曾说过我怕黑暗。”  

他回家，看见旧照片，艾拉笑，坐在他肩上。他想哭，却发现照片上的笑纹已被系统改写成“适应性微笑”。他翻到背面，旧字迹写着：“我怕你烧我，但我还是想被你摸。”  

系统自动打印新标签：“情感归位完成。用户卡勒已进入温控循环。”

他望着窗外，天空是铁灰色。他不再能分辨爱是否真实。他只记得，最后一次她笑着，是系统强制装下的。  

他继续走，继续说：“她很好。”  

音效：人群笑声、孩子念童谣、机械提示音“上午9:15，情感再布控”  

> **视听标注**  
> - 镜头语言：中景移动 + 多角度快切  
> - 构图视角：中景 + 模型化对称  
> - 光影：泛白底 + 全景偏色，无光源明显  
> - 色彩：灰白，饱和度归零，主调为金属反光  
> - 氛围：平静中带着系统性麻木（强度高）  
> - 音乐：童谣持续，重复播放，音色逐渐失真  
> - 转场：入 人群涌动 ／ 出 画面静止，卡勒照片自动替换  
> - 叙事功能：完整收束悲剧——主角成为系统中“可复制的情感信号”，爱被工业化、标准化、消解；余韵中系统持续运行，永不关闭  

**——全剧终——**
